base: factory 007 Quatrefoil, unmirrored (Fallback B), face 16 x 17 mm

base_decision.recorded: docs/collections/cataphracta.md header (2026-09-24: 'Chelonia (007 Quatrefoil) and Phrynosoma (016 Star) go lost wax on the real factory stock, not procedural heads') and the lane's TASK.md ('Logan chose lost wax on the real factory 007 Quatrefoil stock (Fallback B), unmirrored, not a procedural head')
base_decision.route: Fallback B: the real 007 stock, unmirrored, lost wax

draft_clamp.note: Lost wax and no painted layer: no draft clamp runs, so no bite.

notes: Lost wax: 15.83% of the surface would undercut a two-part pull (worst 61.4 deg) — fine for investment, but this pattern cannot move to sand as-is.
8 CAD parts stand on the band (8 joined, 0 cut, 0 separate), not judged here: the built ring judges them.
Undercut 0–358° on the crest: 245.0 mm² leaning to 61° — no single layer explains it.

gates.gate: 0 self-crossings on the ring and on every made part
solids and parts notes empty, every part joined
field Castable under lost wax at the 0.8 mm fill
land widths: every section under 0.8 mm named with its bench treatment

by_feature.bench: The factory stock's own edges and the seam fillets: as the stock casts. Thinnest single-ray section read here: 0.000 mm.
The flippers' trailing edges where they meet the lobes: fill from the flipper's root. Satin brush. Thinnest single-ray section read here: 0.018 mm.
The beak's tip and the eyes' bulges: relief on the head, filling from the neck. Leave as cast; touch the beak with a fine file. Thinnest single-ray section read here: 0.002 mm.
by_feature.feature: the head: beak, eyes, neck folds

by_feature.bench: The scute seams' groove walls and the marginal rim where it meets the table: fill from the shell. Clean the seams with a fine graver. Thinnest single-ray section read here: 0.017 mm.
by_feature.feature: the carapace: scute seams and marginal rim

by_feature.bench: The tail's point on the cusp: fills from the shell's rear. Leave as cast. Thinnest single-ray section read here: 0.000 mm.

land_widths.method: dfm::part_sections over the whole finished ring, then the same one-ray read per face grouped by the feature it lies in; a read is 'supported' when the ray, once out, re-enters metal within support_gap_mm, or metal lies within it straight beneath the exit toward the finger axis (a relief flank on the metal it fills from), else it is a fin or lip with air behind it

Sand-slot widths are a screening check, not a sand-strength model
Radial wall is not the minimum thickness in every direction
Channel volumes overlap at junctions and omit melt/handling losses
Separately cored geometry needs a core and assembly plan

notes: 370.37 mm² carries less than 0.0° draft, including bore walls; review drag and pattern finish
Sample spacing 0.100 × 0.100 mm; obstruction tolerance 0.020 mm. Features between samples may be missed. This checks rigid withdrawal, not sand strength or metal flow.

setup.bench_notes: Lost wax on the factory 007 Quatrefoil, unmirrored. A hawksbill turtle swims across the table: its shell on the middle, a flipper on each lobe, its head down one along-ring cusp and its tail the other. Sprue from the palm. At the bench: clean the scute seams with a fine graver, leave the shell's plates bright and the flippers' scales satin.

release_gate.note: No explicit per-gate waiver from Logan is quoted: none exists in the repository. The counts sit in each block's release field.
release_gate.process_decision: Logan, docs/collections/cataphracta.md header (2026-09-24): "Chelonia (007 Quatrefoil) and Phrynosoma (016 Star) go lost wax on the real factory stock"
release_gate.rule: CLAUDE.md, 'Manufacturing analysis speaks in the sand's numbers': under lost wax the pull statistics are still measured and reported (with an explicit 'cannot move to sand as-is' note when undercut exists) but never gate; only fill and detail do, at investment floors
release_gate.status: not applicable under lost wax, by the doctrine's own rule; reported, never gated

template_class.why: brief.md, Template gate: 'template_class: procedural for an unpainted node-built ring, stock for bare factory stock, painted otherwise'. Chelonia is factory stock carrying eight made parts, not bare stock, so it is 'painted' by that rule (3 MB budget); it carries no painted layer.
